props.subtitle: Marketing and communications in insurance

props.title: Make Complexity Legible
props.content: In financial services, we'd start by deciding the few ideas your audience must walk away with, then shape the data, design and story around them.

props.title: AIG: When Stakes Are High: Reintroducing AIG to the Market
props.summary: We designed the keynote visual system and presentation for AIG's first Investor Day in over a decade, including hundreds of slides, graphs and charts, plus environmental and simulcast event branding.

props.title: Android Enterprise: Hyper-Targeted Consideration Campaign
props.summary: We made a 16-page eBook on mobile device management in financial services, a research-driven blog post and promotional social posts, with content aimed at sub-sectors including banking, insurance, investing and fintech.

final.explanation: AIG is our most direct insurance work. Android Enterprise is adjacent: it was a technology campaign for financial services, with insurance as one of several sub-sectors. We'd start by pinning down who you need to reach, whether investors, customers or IT buyers, because that shapes everything after it.
